policy: Explicit reviewed parallel allowlist; new/unreviewed files warn and run exclusively, never disappear. F and N share a resource-limited pool (default request eight, configurable 1–32); E drains that pool. No directory/name inference. Original deadlines, assertions and host opt-in skips remain unchanged.
reviewBasis: Native entries use the source-audited per-file inventory in the coordinator's parallel-test design (runtime 14/15/3/5 split); F entries were read with their implementation imports. Initial scheduling reviews assumed two workers, not proven timing margins. The requested eight-worker default still requires native execution acceptance with unchanged deadlines. Re-review when resource/fixture behavior changes.

files.reason: Reviewed pure directory/ancestry/display grouping with synthetic catalogues; Jiti fsCache false, no native SDK work or shared writes. Independent source review confirmed isolation.
Reviewed fixed immutable source reads and assertions only; no React mount, SDK, environment changes or shared writes. Genuine desktop/mobile behavior remains separate browser acceptance.

Reviewed pure graph/request/plan tests plus native path-state and inventory checks in unique mkdtemp roots. Temporary files and injected Git/project interfaces stay private; no fixed ports, SDK construction, shared writes or process signalling. Cases remain serial.

Reviewed single serial case with private Git repositories, worktrees, agent storage and synthetic SDK session files; in-process routes, fake wrapper registries and refusal probes stay process-local. Git effects are awaited, cleanup targets only the owned root; no server, model request, shared-source write or host-service access.

Source and transitive cleanup helpers reviewed: each case owns private Git repositories/worktrees and agent settings/reviews; scratch and descriptor helpers stay in private roots, with no shared-source writes, fixed ports or peer signalling. FS mocks and env changes remain serial within the file's separate Node process. Historical Node 24 duration is advisory, not a deadline or concurrency reservation.

Source and transitive discard/cleanup helpers reviewed: private per-case repositories, worktrees and agent storage contain destructive/race probes; scratch files use worker-private TMP and signalling targets owned children/groups. Process-local mocks/env require serial cases, not cross-file exclusivity. No shared-source writes or fixed port dependency found; historical duration is advisory.

Reviewed real Git operations use one private per-file agent/root and unique repositories. PATH shims, registries and lazy observer imports are process-local; settings/reviews/records and scratch stay private, with no listener, source write or machine-wide idle assumption. Preserve serial cases and native-effect settlement; historical duration is advisory.

Reviewed per-case private Git roots and agent storage; session/terminal maps, reservations, FS fault injection and env changes are local to this file's Node process. No shared-source writes/fixed ports or unscoped peer signals found. Keep cases serial, original ten-second waits and awaited native effects/reservation release; historical duration is advisory.

Reviewed native Git/SDK lifecycle and cross-repository cases: private fixture repositories, worktree containers and agent services; faux model responses, offline construction and awaited shutdown/disposal. No shared-source writes, fixed ports or unscoped peer signals found. Keep nested cases serial; priority is historical, not a deadline or wider-worker proof.

Reviewed private per-case repositories and agent settings/reviews, real Git effects and synthetic SDK responses. Cancellation notifications and provider/listener state are process-local; settings locks and native targets remain fixture-bound. Preserve serial cases and awaited shutdown, with no source writes or listener dependency. Historical priority only.

Reviewed inert fake sessions and controlled idle-clock advancement: no real SDK session construction, elapsed idle wait, shell or persistent run. Fresh-loader/env/timer changes are private to one Node process and restored serially; pinned runner disables Jiti filesystem caching. Import-heavy historical priority, not permission to change timing assertions.

Reviewed fake-session/deferred lifecycle tests with real private-agent journal/activity persistence, locks and atomic writes. Shutdown gates settle before teardown; apparent shared-cwd shell case records arguments without execution. Process-local timer mocks retain the genuine 999/1000ms boundary and serial cases. No shared-source writes or fixed service; historical priority only.

Reviewed private directories, symlink aliases and persisted SDK fixtures; reservation/session/terminal maps and injected startup harness are process-local. Refused terminal admission happens before PTY loading/spawn, and deferred startups/leases settle. Keep cases serial and native path assertions unchanged; no source writes or fixed ports. Historical priority only.

Reviewed in-process Request/route calls over private agent/repository/worktree fixtures. Trust JSON/locks and common-Git identity markers stay fixture-bound; busy-session/admitted-root caches are process-local and destruction is awaited. No HTTP listener, shared-source writes or host state. Preserve serial env changes and original native Git budgets; historical priority only.

Reviewed native SHA-1/SHA-256, shallow/history/status/registration cases in private repositories; scripts, object removal and local file-URL clones stay fixture-bound. Capture caches are process-local; child Git and at-most-three-way detail reads are awaited. Elapsed diagnostic is not a timing assertion. Keep 15-second child bounds and serial cases; historical priority only.

Admitted-root/capture caches and env changes are process-local; native Git reads are awaited. No bound listener, shared-source writes or host configuration. Keep cases serial and original stale-state assertions; historical priority only.
